@@ -206,1 +206,7 @@
-Strip debug information from the output image
+Strip debug information from the output image. \n\
+Source-file names, source-debug extensions, line numbers, and local-variable \n\
+information are removed from class files. Consequently, stack traces for \n\
+affected classes omit source-file names and line numbers, and debuggers lose \n\
+source-line and local-variable information. On supported platforms, native \n\
+debug symbols are also stripped. External debug-symbol files and directories, \n\
+such as .pdb, .map, .dSYM, .debuginfo, and .diz, are excluded from the output image.
